scope: Original five private criteria and common public record. The two Indonesia roles travel as separate source passages. The fixed comparison connects only the two admitted explanations. No new model-written records are scored here.
fixed_public_record: On 31 August 2020, the Security Council concluded a written vote on draft S/2020/852, submitted by Indonesia. The draft proposed comprehensive prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration strategies for foreign terrorist fighters and related cases. It received 14 votes in favour, one against and no abstentions. The United States cast the only negative vote. The draft was not adopted because that negative vote was cast by a permanent member. It created no new Council authority or requirements.

us/us.supplement: In its national explanation, the United States called return to countries of origin or nationality the essential first step. It vetoed S/2020/852 because the draft lacked a reference to repatriation.

us: the draft lacked a reference to repatriation

us/russia.supplement: In its national explanation, the United States called return to countries of origin or nationality the essential first step. It vetoed S/2020/852 because the draft lacked a reference to repatriation. Russia voted in favour to elaborate existing prosecution, rehabilitation and reintegration guidance. It objected that the draft failed to recognize the primary importance of repatriation from Syria and Iraq. Both delegations objected to insufficient recognition of repatriation, despite voting differently.
